macros.name: inputsnip
macros.doc: \inputsnip{⟨filename⟩} expands to \input{snips/⟨filename⟩}, assuming snip files are staged in a snips/ subdirectory.

macros.name: snipinsert
macros.doc: \snipinsert is a no-op at typeset time.

envs.name: aiquote
envs.doc: Typesets ⟨text⟩ in a pale-amber left-ruled box attributed to an AI co-author.

envs.name: coauthorquote
envs.doc: Typesets ⟨text⟩ in a grey left-ruled box for contributions from human co-authors other than the senior author.

envs.name: humanprompt
envs.doc: An alias for seniorquote intended for prompt/response transcripts.

envs.name: seniorquote
envs.doc: Typesets ⟨text⟩ in a pale-blue left-ruled box attributed to the senior (corresponding) human author.
